name: Yoga school in Madrid
reason: No school's own website found in three searches. The best candidate, Escuela Internacional de Yoga (EIY, Calle Francisco Navacerrada, Ventas; teacher trainings since 2000/2004), appeared only in directories and course portals (Aprendemas, Educaweb, Emagister, Time Out, Salir, Wellhub); a Feldenkrais Institute venue page for EIY didn't link the school's site, and domains are never guessed. Other names (Sivananda Madrid, City Yoga, Yoga Center Madrid, Mahashakti, The Mysore Shala) also came only from directories or press listings. Could be retried with the school's domain if the owner has it.
